$comment: openspec/changes/publiccode-github-harvest. The harvest flow on the publiccode schema, the OpenRegister mapping it writes through, and the Componenten catalogue that makes harvested components searchable. The shard synchronizations the flow names are NOT seeded here: OpenRegister skips an object whose register is missing, so an install without integriq would never get them. PubliccodeHarvestService::setUp() writes them from lib/Settings/publiccode-github-shards.json when an administrator asks.

x-openregister-flows.name: GitHub publiccode harvest
x-openregister-flows.description: Reads every publiccode.yml on GitHub into the publiccode schema (openspec/changes/publiccode-github-harvest). Each shard searches one file size range, because a GitHub code search stops at 1,000 results. The shards hang directly off the triggers and never off each other: chained, each shard reruns its search once per page the previous shard found (12 runs became 3,472 on 2026-08-13). Each shard has its own fetch, decode, map and write steps rather than one shared tail: a place that several steps write into keeps only the last step's items, so a shared tail processed 3 of 24 shards' pages on 2026-10-01. The end node waits for every shard (join): an end node stops the whole run, so without the join the first shard to finish stopped the other 23. Ships disabled; set it up and switch it on in the OpenCatalogi admin settings, section GitHub harvest. Needs integriq with its github-api and github-raw sources.

publiccode-github-hit.name: GitHub publiccode.yml to publiccode
publiccode-github-hit.description: Turns one GitHub code search hit with its decoded publiccode.yml (at publiccode.body) into a publiccode object under `component`. Optional fields use |default('') and the cast unsetIfValue==, because a bare dot path whose key is missing renders the path itself as a literal string. Lists pass through json_encode and jsonToArray.

mapping.component.name: {{ publiccode.body.name|default('') }}
mapping.component.releaseDate: {{ publiccode.body.releaseDate is defined and publiccode.body.releaseDate ? publiccode.body.releaseDate|date('Y-m-d', false) : '' }}
mapping.component.itConformsTo: {% set conforms = [] %}{% for standard, conforms_to in publiccode.body.it.conforme|default({}) %}{% if conforms_to %}{% set conforms = conforms|merge([standard]) %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ conforms|json_encode }}

objects.title: Componenten
objects.summary: Herbruikbare software met een publiccode.yml, gevonden op GitHub
objects.description: Elke publiccode.yml op GitHub die de GitHub-harvest van OpenCatalogi vindt. Zoek op naam, licentie, platform of status, en lees per component wie het onderhoudt.
